faqHeading: Common Questions About Moving in Los Angeles

faq.q: Do Los Angeles movers from Better Life Moving do cross-country moves?
faq.a: Yes. Coast-to-coast moves are a main part of our LA work, quoted at a flat rate and carried on our own truck.

faq.q: How are local Los Angeles moves billed?
faq.a: Local moves are billed hourly, with travel time from our yard added, and a 2-hour minimum that includes travel time. Distance across the city counts too, since the clock covers travel between addresses.

faq.q: Can you hold my things until my LA apartment is ready?
faq.a: Yes. Storage is priced by the cubic feet your items take up, and we deliver on the date you choose.

faq.q: Can the crew pack my Los Angeles home before a long move?
faq.a: Yes. Full or partial packing can be added, and long hauls are packed with the distance in mind.

faq.q: How long has Better Life Moving worked in Los Angeles?
faq.a: The company was founded in Boston in 2022, and Los Angeles is one of the markets we've added since.

faqClosing: Have a question we haven't covered? See the FAQ page for billing and booking details.

closing.body: Send the date and both addresses. Local or cross-country, a manager will walk you through the price.
